name: The Delmarva Chess Club
notes: Welcome to The Delmarva Chess Club! We usually have weekly Online Club Matches on Tuesday evenings. Pre-registration starts at 6 pm, and matches begin at 7 pm. Our goal is to complete the tournament by 9 pm. However, depending on the number of participants, it may occasionally be as late as 10 pm. Important note: Minors must have permission from their parent or guardian to join the club and play in tournaments. Also, members may only have one active account in this club. Furthermore, we have our in-person Club meetings on Wednesday evenings at Wor Wic Community College (WWCC) in the new Patricia and Alan Guerrieri Technology Center (GTC), Second floor, Room 204, from 5:30 to 8:30 pm. We provide chess sets and clocks, so you won't need anything. Bring a friend! Here is the address to the WWCC: Wor-Wic Community College, 32000 Campus Dr, Salisbury, MD 21804 If you are interested in Chess and want to learn to play or improve your game and live on the Eastern Shore of Delmarva or the surrounding area, I invite you to join the club. There is absolutely no cost or obligation! If you need help signing up, navigating the website, or have questions, please don't hesitate to contact me. I would be happy to walk you through the process. Please send me an instant message at coachbrian , and I'll get back to you as soon as possible. Thanks much, Brian Banks
